Brazil's Roswell is how a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience labels the 1996 Varginha incident, still unsolved more than twenty-five years later. Witnesses in that Brazilian city reported a strange craft and beings unlike anything local. The story drew soldiers, doctors, and reporters into its orbit.

Rogan reviews the claims piece by piece: the sightings, the alleged capture, and the official denials. He asks why this case, among so many, refuses to fade. The segment keeps the tale in circulation as an archive record, presented as a mystery, with its strangest details intact for listeners to weigh.
